notes.title: Update in 2023
notes.content:
When you were about to forget me, I reappeared again...

1. New Units: Bug-flash (P2  of the final Boss), venom (high-speed Unit).

2. Adjustment of blueprint acquisition method.

3. Adjustment of some weapons data.

4. Other updates and corrections ...

A little update:

1. To improve  Gun-Missile
2.The external Armored Core unit no longer needs a printer to restore the armor-form

notes.title: New game mode !
notes.content:
adding the Adventure mode to replace the original fixed stage mode. Players can travel by carrier in several star maps, collect resources and defeat powerful enemies.
